tools.name: list_mm7_capabilities
tools.description: List tools available for the current access tier.

tools.name: get_company_requisites
tools.description: Legal and bank requisites of OOO MM7.

tools.name: list_business_activities
tools.description: Business activities / service lines of MM7.

tools.name: get_edo_identity
tools.description: Current EDO operator and identifier for MM7.

tools.name: get_contact_channels
tools.description: Public contact channels: phone, email, website, support.

tools.name: get_contract_status
tools.description: Contract status bound to the API key (stub until 1C/B24 wiring).

tools.name: request_service_agreement_edo
tools.description: Request a template service agreement via EDO. MVP accepts the request into a local queue (no live EDO send).

tools.name: check_its_subscription
tools.description: Check 1C:ITS subscription status by product registration number. Same Partner API as the form on mm7.ru.

tools.name: check_1c_product_by_reg
tools.description: Check a 1C product by registration number: whether the number is known and a short ITS contract summary. Same API as «Check product» on mm7.ru.

tools.name: lookup_rrp
tools.description: Look up recommended retail price (RRP) by product name fragment or code. Covers firm 1C, Bitrix CMS (Управление сайтом), Bitrix24 (cloud+box), and Cleverence Mobile SMARTS «Склад 15». Optional vendor filter: 1c | bitrix-cms | bitrix24-cloud | bitrix24-box | cleverence-wh15. Returns RRP only — never

tools.name: get_1c_license_captcha
tools.description: Fetch a portal.1c.ru captcha image for license PIN / owner requests. Returns captcha_id + image_base64. Then call request_pin_codes_state, request_license_owner_data, or request_reserve_pin_code.

tools.name: request_pin_codes_state
tools.description: Request current PIN-code state from portal.1c.ru (active/cancelled/free). Client API key required. Requires captcha from get_1c_license_captcha. Result is emailed by 1C — not returned in the tool response body.

tools.name: request_license_owner_data
tools.description: Request license owner data check via portal.1c.ru. Client API key required. Requires captcha from get_1c_license_captcha. Result is emailed by 1C.

tools.name: request_reserve_pin_code
tools.description: Request a reserve/additional PIN from portal.1c.ru. Client API key required. Requires captcha + current active PIN. Result is emailed by 1C. Side-effect on the license kit — use carefully.

tools.name: list_its_products
tools.description: List ITS/KP products available for renewal quotes (RRP floor).

tools.name: quote_its_renewal
tools.description: Quote ITS renewal: check subscription by registration number and return catalog price for product_sku (never below RRP).

tools.name: request_its_renewal_invoice
tools.description: Request an invoice for ITS renewal. Provide registration number, product_sku, and payer requisites. Phase 1 accepts into a queue (no live 1C invoice yet).

tools.name: subscribe_its_renewal
tools.description: Subscribe to an ITS renewal reminder. When the subscription is near expiry, MM7 will send an invoice via the chosen channel. Phase 1 stores the preference only.

tools.name: list_cloud_trial_offers
tools.description: Full catalog of 1C:GRM demo configurations (live Partner API) plus Fresh. Each offer includes description, docs_url (v8.1c.ru / solutions.1c.ru), category, kits, required fields. Filter with query/category. Then call request_cloud_trial.

tools.name: request_cloud_trial
tools.description: Order a 1C:GRM cloud demo (or queue Fresh). Required for GRM: product_sku (from list_cloud_trial_offers), inn, phone, email, company_name, contact_name (ФИО). Optional: kit (Файловый/Клиент-серверный), portal_login, employee_count, seats. Creates demo via Partner API /orders/submit; login usually em

tools.name: get_cloud_trial_status
tools.description: Poll cloud demo status after request_cloud_trial. Required: email (same as in the order) + request_id (ctr_…) or order_id. Returns ready, demo_url when the base is up, application status, trial dates. Poll every 1–5 minutes while provisioning.

tools.name: submit_counterparty_profile
tools.description: Leave your organization / agent profile at MM7 for later billing and contact. Send company requisites (INN, address, bank, director, EDO id), who you are, and optionally your own MCP URL for two-way agent callbacks. Stored at MM7 (profile_id). Do not put secret tokens — only https MCP URL + auth hin

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "submit_counterparty_profile" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Leave your organization / agent profile at MM7 for later billing and contact. Send company requisites (INN, address, bank, director, EDO id), who you are, and o…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_contact_channels, get_cloud_trial_status · Private data: get_contact_channels, get_contract_status, request_pin_codes_state, request_license_owner_data, request_reserve_pin_code, submit_counterparty_profile · Public sink: get_contact_channels, request_service_agreement_edo, subscribe_its_renewal, request_cloud_trial, get_cloud_trial_status, submit_counterparty_profile.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_contact_channels, get_cloud_trial_status · Private data: get_contact_channels, get_contract_status, request_pin_codes_state, request_license_owner_data, request_reserve_pin_code, submit_counterparty_profile · Public sink: get_contact_channels, request_service_agreement_edo, subscribe_its_renewal, request_cloud_trial, get_cloud_trial_status, submit_counterparty_profile

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
